name: Outcome-based pricing
short_description: A pricing model for consulting and IT services in which clients pay for measurable business results, often as build fees plus recurring retainers or licences, instead of billable hours.

evidence.quote: once you move from hourly to outcome-based pricing
move away from hourly billing and toward outcome-based pricing
Outcome pricing flips this entire model on its head by charging for results instead of minutes.
